shortDescription: Disconnect the Management Server from Check Point's Infinity Portal.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: force
options.description: Disconnect the Management Server from Check Point Infinity Portal, and reset the connection locally, regardless of the result in the Infinity Portal. This flag can be used if the disconnect-cloud-services command failed. Since with this flag this command affects only the local configuration, make sure to disconnect the Management Server in the Infinity Portal as well.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
